description: Event Check: did a US public company actually FILE this news, or is it just going around? Give a ticker or name and the claim (CEO resigned, acquisition, results, bankruptcy, restatement, cyber incident, layoffs...). We map it to the required SEC 8-K item, pull the company's recent filings from EDGAR, and quote the sentence that states it. FILED only when one sentence carries the claim's names and roles; otherwise FILED_RELATED, NO_FILING_YET (4-business-day filing window), NOT_A_FILING_EVENT or NOT_FOUND. Deterministic. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: GET https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/event-check, $0.005 via x402.)
name: event_check
